'''Kips Haogin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] in [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. He was present during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], stationed in the crisis command center within the [[rakghoul tunnels]] and was specializing as a supply officer for THORN volunteers affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He would later be stationed in the rakghoul tunnels on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
